prioritized_defects.description: In the encrypted join/leave multicast branch, the message is decrypted after the notify is received, but there is no control-flow path that proceeds from decryption to completing the join/leave handling; the yes-branch ends at Decrypt message, which makes the required encrypted-notify handling incomplete.
prioritized_defects.evidence: The requirements state that an agent sends notify to join/leave multicast group and that the message is decrypted only if it is encrypted. In the diagram, the encrypted branch goes N6 -> N7 -> N8, but there is no subsequent action representing completion of the join/leave operation after decryption, unlike the non-encrypted branch which at least reaches receipt. This leaves the encrypted notify scenario semantically unfinished.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Add a post-decryption flow that continues the join/leave processing after N8, or restructure the join/leave handling so decryption feeds into the same multicast-group update activity as the plain branch.

prioritized_defects.description: The diagram does not explicitly model the actual multicast group join and leave behavior; it only models sending and receiving a notify message. This misses the required join/leave multicast group functionality as an activity outcome.
prioritized_defects.evidence: R5 requires allowing agents to join and leave multicast group. The drawn behavior for that use case is limited to choosing encryption, deciding whether the message is encrypted, sending notify, receiving notify, and possibly decrypting it. No activity indicates an agent joining or leaving the multicast group itself, so the required group-management behavior is not represented.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Include explicit join multicast group and leave multicast group actions after the notify handling, with the notify message serving as the trigger for those state changes.

final_recommendation: Repair the blocking control-flow omission first (D1), then address the missing requirement coverage for explicit join/leave behavior (D2).
